column2: {title} provides facility status at Primary Health Centres (PHCs) under the public health system. It supports monitoring of service readiness at the grassroots level and comparisons across administrative regions. Data are prepared by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides performance-related indicator data for RCH reporting on Pentavalent 3 coverage, including DPT 3. It supports monitoring of immunization and service delivery trends and helps assess estimated need using population and demographic parameters. Source is the HMIS portal under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides State/UT-wise manpower data for specialists posted or working at Community Health Centres (CHCs), including vacancy and shortfall information. It supports planning, staffing gap analysis, and allocation decisions for Family Welfare services. Data use sanctioned positions, excluding certain surplus effects under older norms. Published by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare).

{title} provides State/UT-wise figures for sanctioned and vacancy/shortfall positions related to Laboratory Technicians working at Primary Health Centres (PHCs) and Community Health Centres (CHCs). Useful for assessing availability of frontline diagnostics capacity and planning workforce recruitment. Compiled by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare across States/UTs.

{title} provides availability details of health centres under India’s public health system. It supports planning, gap analysis, and monitoring of facility distribution at district level. Source data is compiled from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare), aligned to NRHM reporting timelines.

{title} provides State/UT-wise sanctioned position and vacancy/shortfall details for radiographers posted at Community Health Centres (CHCs). The dataset supports workforce planning and monitoring of staffing gaps across health facilities. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides State/UT-wise counts of allopathic doctors available at Primary Health Centres located in tribal areas. It is used for monitoring staffing levels and supporting planning and resource allocation for family welfare and primary health services. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} gives State/UT-wise counts of surgeons sanctioned and available at Community Health Centres (CHCs), compiled for family welfare and primary healthcare planning. The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare) is the source. Coverage is at State/UT level.

{title} provides comparisons of HMIS indicators using item-wise records. It supports monitoring and performance analysis of facility reporting through the financial year. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare). Figures are provisional, and updates are irregular.

{title} compiles the status and performance of key HMIS indicators across sub districts under the health management information system. It is intended for monitoring service delivery and comparing indicator trends across administrative units. The source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare). Figures are provisional.

{title} provides periodic reporting of health management information system (HMIS) indicators at item level across public and private facilities. It supports monitoring of service delivery and administrative review for family welfare and health programmes. The dataset is from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides facility-wise performance data on outpatient attendance for allopathic public facilities, aggregated and presented by range. Useful for monitoring service delivery capacity and utilisation across reporting periods at district-linked facility scales. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare. Data are updated with HMIS facility definitions and exclude medical colleges, for facility-wise reporting districts.

{title} presents key HMIS indicators across sub districts. It supports monitoring of health information system outcomes and performance review for program management. Figures are provisional and reflect state-reported values under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} presents performance of key HMIS indicators across sub-districts. It supports monitoring of health system performance, planning and follow-up using provisional figures reported by the state. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare).

{title} provides performance data on key HMIS indicators. It supports district-level monitoring and planning of family welfare and health services using HMIS reporting. Figures are provisional and reported by the respective state.

{title} is a report on key HMIS indicators used for monitoring performance. Figures are provisional. Data are reported by the state and compiled by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare’s health department.

{title} provides performance figures for key HMIS indicators. The dataset supports monitoring and comparison of health system management outcomes at district and sub-district level using HMIS data. Figures are provisional and have been reported by the respective state.

{title} provides performance data for key Health Management Information System (HMIS) indicators across sub-districts. The series supports monitoring service delivery and reviewing indicator trends across sub-districts for health planning. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} presents the performance of key HMIS indicators. It supports monitoring of health service delivery and program management using state-submitted HMIS data. The records are provisional and reflect state-submitted values reported under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} presents the performance of key Health Management Information System (HMIS) indicators. It uses provisional figures reported by the respective state, covering the financial year, and supports monitoring at district level.

{title} provides performance of key HMIS indicators across sub districts. It supports health system monitoring and comparative analysis for planning and evaluation by program managers. Data are based on provisional figures reported by the respective state.

{title} provides performance of key HMIS indicators for sub-districts. It compiles provisional reporting from the respective state and uses the HMIS framework under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides performance data for HMIS indicators across sub-districts. The compilation supports monitoring of health system indicator trends and performance review for the financial year. Data are reported by the respective state under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} presents performance of key HMIS indicators across sub-districts, based on reports provided by states. The dataset supports monitoring and program management under the Health and Family Welfare system. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} reports performance of selected HMIS indicators. It supports monitoring and review of facility and health management information system outcomes at sub-district level. Figures are provisional for the financial year. Updates follow the reporting cycle.

{title} provides performance values for key HMIS indicators. It uses provisional figures reported by the respective state for the financial year. HMIS indicator performance supports monitoring, review, and planning in the health system.

{title} provides provisional performance figures for key HMIS indicators across subdistricts. It supports monitoring, review, and comparison of HMIS indicator achievements for family welfare and health services. Data are reported by the respective state, under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides provisional performance of key HMIS indicators across sub-districts. It supports monitoring and review of health service delivery using HMIS indicator reporting by the respective state. Figures cover the financial year.

{title} provides provisional performance of key HMIS indicators across subdistricts. It compiles indicator reporting submitted by respective states to the HMIS. Figures may be updated in later revisions. Coverage is for the financial year.

{title} provides combined household and houselisting information collected under India’s Annual Health Survey. It supports health research, planning, and monitoring by giving a structured view of households and dwelling characteristics. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare). It is published at annual periodicity and is irregularly updated on the OGD portal.

{title} provides provisional performance of key HMIS indicators reported for sub-districts. It supports monitoring, benchmarking, and program management for Family Welfare or health services using state reporting. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare. Coverage is for the financial year.

{title} reports performance of key Health Management Information System (HMIS) indicators. It supports monitoring service delivery and identifying gaps in routine health programme outcomes. Data are provisional and reported by the respective state.

{title} reports performance of key HMIS indicators across sub-districts. It supports monitoring of health information system implementation and indicator tracking for program management. Data are provisional and reported by the respective state.

{title} reports performance of key Health Management Information System (HMIS) indicators across sub-districts. It supports monitoring service delivery and identifying gaps in family welfare-related health outcomes. Data are provisional for the financial year.

{title} reports provisional performance of key HMIS indicators across sub-districts. It supports monitoring of health service delivery and planning at local levels. Data are reported by states and reflect the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} reports the performance of key HMIS indicators across sub-districts. It supports monitoring of health service delivery under the HMIS framework and comparative sub-district analysis. Figures are provisional and are compiled from state reporting.

{title} reports the performance of key Health Management Information System (HMIS) indicators. Provisional figures are compiled by the respective state. It helps monitor service delivery and program progress under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides performance figures for key HMIS indicators. It supports monitoring, evaluation, and sub-district health planning by tracking indicator performance. Data are provisional for the financial year and reported by respective states.

{title} provides performance of key HMIS indicators. It supports program monitoring and evaluation for Family Welfare and related service delivery. Provisional figures cover the financial year. Data are reported by the respective state and shared by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides provisional performance of HMIS indicators across sub-districts. It supports monitoring and review of HMIS performance at sub-district level. The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare reports indicator figures shared by respective states.
